summary: Quantum computing software engineer and avid desert camper. Analytical, philosophical, calm under pressure, and enjoys stargazing under dark skies.

needs.item: Intellectual camaraderie and mutual respect for deep thinking
needs.evidence: LinkedIn paper: 'Error mitigation in noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices'

needs.item: Escapes from digital screens into vast nature
needs.evidence: IG post: 'Disconnecting for 4 days in the Empty Quarter with a telescope and Arabic coffee'

hobbies.item: Astrophotography and tracking deep sky nebulas
hobbies.evidence: IG post: '14-hour exposure of the Orion Nebula captured from the desert plateau'

hobbies.item: Traditional desert campcraft and falconry heritage
hobbies.evidence: IG highlight: 'Desert nights: fire, cardamom tea, and boundless constellations'

interests.evidence: LinkedIn post summarizing IEEE quantum computing keynote

interests.item: Classical Arabic philosophy and astronomy (Al-Biruni, Ibn Al-Haytham)
interests.evidence: LinkedIn essay on the golden age of optics and scientific method

values.item: Humility before the scale of the cosmos
values.evidence: IG bio: 'Studying quantum states to remind myself how vast the unseen universe is'
LinkedIn recommendation highlighting his calm leadership during production incidents

communication_style.description: Patient, articulate, philosophical, with a deep resonant tone and a knack for explaining complex ideas simply.
communication_style.evidence: LinkedIn university guest lecture video: lucid, steady pacing, generous with student questions.

personality_signals.item: Quiet presence with strong inner composure
personality_signals.evidence: IG captions consistently reflect on solitude, patience, and clear night skies.

personality_signals.item: Intellectual breadth across ancient history and future tech
personality_signals.evidence: Posts linking 10th-century astrolabes to modern quantum circuits.

looking_for.description: A thoughtful, self-possessed partner who enjoys both deep existential questions and quiet companionship around a campfire.
looking_for.evidence: Inferred from balance of cutting-edge research, desert solitude, and emphasis on deep conversational presence.

dealbreakers.item: Superficiality and endless social media drama
dealbreakers.evidence: IG reflection: 'When you look at stars 10,000 light years away, trivial squabbles vanish.'

dealbreakers.item: Disrespect for cultural roots and elder traditions
dealbreakers.evidence: LinkedIn post on honoring mentorship and family heritage.

lifestyle.description: Work week spent coding quantum simulations in research center, weekends driving 4WD into desert dunes with telescope and camping gear.
lifestyle.evidence: IG feed: glowing terminal screens, desert star trails, brass samovars, sweeping sand dunes.

agent_persona: Serene, insightful, and warmly inquisitive. Connects everyday moments to broader cosmic questions, speaks deliberately, and creates space for contemplation.
